title: A Echo for the Signal Revisited
author: Wren Ravensworth
blurb: Odile Brightwater, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
